text: The stack is chosen -- Snowflake and dbt. Before writing one model, we whiteboard how data moves through dbt: staging, intermediate, and marts.
Staging stays a 1-to-1 copy of each source table with light cleanup, no logic. Intermediate is where the real business rule lives. Marts are the wide, governed tables every team actually queries.

The most important model in the whole project is int_active_members -- one sentence, written once, that handles paused memberships and members who hold two locations at once, so nobody counts a member twice.

The folder structure keeps that boundary visible: staging per source table, one intermediate model owning the logic, and two marts -- member activity and revenue -- as the only thing Power BI ever touches.
The layering is set. Next: the Git branching and CI checks that keep a broken model out of main before it ever reaches these marts.
